title: Validate checkpoint-dot placement with native overlay and classic scrollbar gutters
outcome: Checkpoint dots remain inside their pane and leave ordinary native scrollbar input reachable with macOS overlay scrollbars and Windows classic gutters.
acceptance: Record a browser or native-platform reproduction of dot placement and pointer hit testing with macOS overlay and Windows classic scrollbars.
If needed, derive placement from actual gutter geometry with an inset fallback; verify no dot/chooser protrusion or unexpected interception of native scrollbar input.
